problem: The swarm currently distinguishes READY capacity and durable returns but lacks privacy-safe worker-supply instrumentation, so a broad identical /wc launch cannot independently measure how many worker invocations actually became allocatable/claimed/executing workers versus idle capacity, collisions, or missing supply.
acceptance: derive worker supply from durable public coordination receipts without reading private conversation content
separate prepared/ready capacity, launch or invocation evidence, successful claims, collisions, started runs, and terminal useful returns
emit deterministic machine-auditable counts and ratios for a bounded wave
missing launch evidence remains UNKNOWN rather than inferred from silence
no queue mutation or Current, Human Accepted, Served promotion
title: Worker Supply Instrumentation v1
mission: Build a privacy-safe derived instrumentation candidate that measures actual worker supply for a bounded /wc wave separately from queue capacity and useful durable output. Consume only public coordination receipts, preserve UNKNOWN where launch evidence is absent, and expose deterministic counts/ratios suitable for the 50-worker stress verifier.

information_gain.reason: The throughput critic found worker invocation/control-loop supply is a dominant bottleneck but current durable evidence cannot distinguish idle READY capacity from missing worker supply.

unblock_value.reason: A bounded 50-worker stress verdict needs supply-side denominators so duplicate, idle, collision and useful-output ratios are interpretable rather than inferred from silence.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Machine-derived supply evidence removes the need for the human to count launched chats or report which chats actually acquired work.

fail_if: a missing launch/worker-supply receipt is silently counted as zero supply
prepared READY capacity is treated as actual launched worker supply
claims without STARTED runs are counted as executing workers
private conversation/transcript data is required to compute the projection
candidate output mutates queue authority or promotes Current/Human Accepted/Served
